problems.problem: Improve the capabilities, alignment, and safety of production Claude models through more effective post-training.
evidence: Anthropic's production models undergo sophisticated post-training processes to enhance their capabilities, alignment, and safety.
Your work will directly impact the quality, safety, and capabilities of our production models.
Conduct research to develop and optimize post-training recipes that directly improve production model quality
problems.rationale: The company needs stronger post-training methods that improve model quality while preserving alignment and safety in production.

problems.problem: Build and scale reliable, efficient infrastructure for fine-tuning and evaluating frontier models.
evidence: Implement and optimize post-training techniques at scale on frontier models
Design, build, and run robust, efficient pipelines for model fine-tuning and evaluation
Are comfortable working with large-scale distributed systems and high-performance computing
problems.rationale: The role is intended to solve the infrastructure and scalability challenges of running post-training workflows on very large models.

problems.problem: Develop better ways to measure and improve model performance across multiple quality and safety dimensions.
evidence: Develop tools to measure and improve model performance across various dimensions
Have experience with training, fine-tuning, or evaluating large language models
problems.rationale: The company needs dependable measurement and evaluation capabilities to identify and improve model behavior across diverse dimensions.

problems.problem: Turn emerging post-training and alignment research into production-ready model improvements.
evidence: Collaborate with research teams to translate emerging techniques into production-ready implementations

You'll work at the intersection of cutting-edge research and production engineering, implementing, scaling, and improving post-training techniques like Constitutional AI, RLHF, and other alignment methodologies.
problems.rationale: The company needs engineers who can bridge research advances and deployable implementations rather than leaving techniques at the experimental stage.

problems.problem: Diagnose and resolve complex failures in training pipelines and model behavior while maintaining operational reliability.
evidence: Debug complex issues in training pipelines and model behavior
Help establish best practices for reliable, reproducible model post-training
This role may require responding to incidents on short-notice, including on weekends.
Maintain clarity when debugging complex, time-sensitive issues
problems.rationale: The production post-training stack requires rapid incident response, sophisticated debugging, and practices that make results reliable and reproducible.

problems.problem: Maintain execution speed and coordination while priorities shift in an ambiguous, high-pressure research environment.
evidence: Thrive in controlled chaos and are energised, rather than overwhelmed, when juggling multiple urgent priorities
Enjoy collaborating across research and engineering disciplines
Can navigate ambiguity and make progress in fast-moving research environments
problems.rationale: The company needs someone who can make progress and coordinate across teams despite urgent work, changing priorities, and unclear paths.
